sharedRules.name: Explosive Payload
sharedRules.description:
Instead of transporting troops, you may use some or all of a Vehicle’s Transport capacity for explosives. A Vehicle carrying an Explosive Payloadwill always explode when destroyed. Each batch of explosives on board increases the blast radius by D3" (this may take it beyond the 6" maximum), and adds 1 to the number of hits inflicted.
A Vehicle with this rule may spend a short Action to detonate itself – assume that the damage exceeded its Resilience by D3. This Vehicle may also be fired upon by friendly troops.
A vehicle with this rule also gains the Volatile (2+) special rule. If it has this special rule twice it instead has the Volatile (3+) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Infection
sharedRules.description:
This unit carries an active strain of the Plague virus, and will infect units that it comes into contact with, potentially turning them into ready-made reinforcements.
This rule allows the player to score extra VPs when using the Infection Secondary Objective.
The rule has no effect against any Robotic or Marauder units.

sharedRules.name: Unstable
sharedRules.description: This unit is so biologically unstable that it may explode in a shower of viscera. Whenever a model with this rule is destroyed, it explodes in the same way as a Vehicle, with a blast radius of 3". The blast will only damage non-Plague units, but anything destroyed by it will be subject to the Infectionrule as if they had been destroyed in Assault.
